Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for a vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. TOP RIGHT — afford (v.付得起(钱)): A clear compact educational illustration of 'afford', specifically its curriculum meaning 'v.付得起(钱)'; show a concrete object or minimal human situation that conveys precisely that meaning.
BOTTOM LEFT — deposit (n.预付定金): a small initial group of blue coins moved toward a reserved product while remaining coins stay grey, down payment mnemonic
BOTTOM RIGHT — instalment (n.分期付款): three evenly spaced small piles of coins along a timeline toward a purchased item, payment in instalments
